10k.note: 10-K describes Charles River as a contract research organization (CRO) providing research models and discovery, safety assessment, manufacturing solutions, and biologics testing services to drug-developer clients. No proprietary therapeutic pipeline.

website.error: Charles River is a CRO/services company; corporate site has no therapeutic pipeline page. Service portfolio (research models, DSA, manufacturing) is not a drug pipeline.

ctgov.note: ctgov hits map to Boston University Charles River Campus (academic) and unrelated client/sponsor trials. None are CRL-proprietary clinical assets.

commercial_product.note: Charles River Laboratories operates three reportable segments: Research Models and Services (RMS), Discovery and Safety Assessment (DSA), and Manufacturing Solutions. All revenue is service-based work performed for biopharma clients on the clients' molecules; CRL does not own clinical-stage therapeutic assets.

excluded_partner_owned.reason: All ctgov entries are either Boston University Charles River Campus academic trials or client-sponsored studies where CRL provided services; per protocol, do not enumerate sponsor's clients' trials for a CRO issuer.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Charles River Laboratories is a contract research organization (CRO) providing research models, discovery and safety assessment, biologics testing, and manufacturing-support services to drug developers. It does not own proprietary therapeutic assets and has no internal P1/P2/P3 pipeline.
